verses.t: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sakabaḷena mukhena byāharanti …pe…. Na sakabaḷena mukhena byāharitabbaṁ. Yo anādariyaṁ paṭicca sakabaḷena mukhena byāharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ādikammikassāti. Tatiyasikkhāpadaṁ niṭṭhitaṁ.
